newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals prices mixed in narrow trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals prices mixed in narrow trade.

text.p: Indian copper and tin prices on Thursday gained while other metals moved in a narrow range, dealers said.
Ready copper rose by 100 rupees to 12,300 rupees on thin supply, shortage of ready stock and fresh physical buying.
Copper was up by 100 rupees on Wednesday.
Tin gained on easing inflows, rising by 200 rupees to 34,400 rupees. It was up by 200 rupees per quintal on Wednesday.
Aluminium was quiet at 7,225 rupees per quintal, zinc at 6,425 rupees and lead at 4,600 rupees amid thin activity. Nickel was steady at 36,500 rupees amid nominal trading.
